In 2024, BBSI didn't nominate anyone new to its board. I found no evidence of a new director being nominated that year.

- **2024 slate:** BBSI's proxy for the June 3, 2024 annual meeting asked stockholders to elect eight directors. The nominees were Thomas J. Carley, Joseph S. Clabby, Thomas B. Cusick, Gary E. Kramer, Anthony Meeker, Carla A. Moradi, Alexandra Morehouse and Vincent P. Price. The proxy also states that all of the nominees were already serving on the board.
- **December 2024:** BBSI created a vice chairman role and appointed Joseph S. Clabby to it. He had been on the board since 2022, and the appointment took effect December 13, 2024. That was a new title for an existing director, not a new nomination.
- **Mark S. Finn:** He was added to the board in April 2025, not 2024. The 2025 proxy says he was selected after the Nominating Committee identified top candidates and the Board vetted them.

If you meant a specific person, Clabby is the most likely match for a 2024 board announcement. If you saw a different name, tell me where and I'll check it.
